items.information:
## Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before April 1, 2023 at 7:00 PM EDT.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:

Nos sentimos muy emocionados de presentar IZCUBE 2023.

¡El torneo más grande de México!
 
Esta ocasión, gracias al Gobierno Municipal de Cuautitlán Izcalli a través del Instituto Municipal de la Juventud, regresamos a este municipio tan representativo del Estado de México.

Con tu asistencia esperamos ser el torneo con mayor número participantes del país hasta ahora.

Ayúdanos a lograrlo y súmate a esta gran experiencia.

IZCUBE 2023 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

Te esperamos en Cuautitlán Izcalli; *Tu Casa Entre los Árboles*.

_____________________________________________

We feel very excited to present IZCUBE 2023.

The biggest competition of Mexico!

This time, thanks to the Municipal Government of Cuautitlan Izcalli through the Municipal Institute of Youth, we are back to this representative city of the State of Mexico.

With your attendance, we hope to see the most number of participants ever in the country by now.

Help us to achieve it and be a part of this great endeavour.

IZCUBE 2023 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We are waiting for you in Cuautitlan Izcalli; *Your Home Between Trees*.

venue.address: 〒143-0016　大田区大森北一丁目10番14号

items.information:
### コンセプト
スピードキュービングチャレンジでは、できるだけ多くの方々に自己記録更新へと"チャレンジ"していただくことを目指しています。

昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。
この状況を緩和するため、1種目1ラウンドのみでシリーズ大会を開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。
#### **BLD I大会の開催種目は 3x3x3 目隠し (1ラウンド) のみです。通常の 3x3x3 キューブ の競技はありません。同日開催のIV大会かV大会にお申し込みください。**

### WCAシリーズ大会
WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

Tokyo Challenge BLD I 2023(**本大会 / 以下、BLD I大会**) 、[Tokyo Challenge IV 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeIV2023)(**以下、IV大会**) 及び[Tokyo Challenge V 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeV2023)(**以下、V大会**) はWCA シリーズ大会です。
BLD I大会、IV大会およびV大会のうち１つの大会だけに参加できます。


### 競技参加者以外の来場要件
**限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。**
当日飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。
**未成年の競技者に対する保護者同伴は、1名とさせていただきます(無料)。18歳以上の競技者は、同伴者なしで来場いただくよう、ご協力をお願いいたします。**
もし追加で同伴者として来場する必要がある場合は、見学者としてお申し込みください。(1000円/1人)
また、会場内の人数制限のため、見学をお断りする場合がございます。あらかじめご了承ください。

### サポーター募集
より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。
後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。

### Concept
Speed Cubing Challenge aims to "challenge" as many people as possible to break their own records.

In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them.
To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions with only one event, one round.
#### **The BLD I competitions are held in 3x3x3 blindfold only (1 round). There will be no regular 3x3x3 Cube competition. Please register for the IV or V competitions held on the same day.**


### WCA Series Competitions
WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can **only** participate in one of them.
If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be accepted, and the others will be invalid.

Tokyo Challenge BLD I 2023 (**This Competition / hereinafter referred to as "Competition BLD I"**), [Tokyo Challenge IV 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeIV2023) (**Competition IV**) and [Tokyo Challenge V 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeV2023) (**Competition V**) are WCA series competitions.
You can participate in only one of the BLD I, IV and V competitions.

### Requirements for non-competitors
**Space is limited in the venue and our priority is allowing as many competitors as possible to compete within our limited venue space.**
It is not possible to watch the competition on the day of the event.
**Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest. Competitors over the age of 18 are encouraged to come without a guest.** 
If you need additional guest, please register as a visitor.　(1,000 yen per visitors)
Please note that due to the limited number of people in the venue, visitors may not be allowed to visit. 

### Supporters Wanted
In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions.
We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

items.information:

items.information:
**Deutsch**

Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur ersten Competition in **Leipzig** in der Geschichte der WCA. Nach über 12 Jahren findet endlich wieder eine Competition in Sachsen statt und wir, das Orga-Team freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig und ein motiviertes Orga-Team. Lasst uns gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass die Competition **Rahn Education Leipzig** ein traditionelles Event in der WCA wird. 

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**


**English**

We cordially invite you to the first competition in **Leipzig** in the history of the WCA. After more than 12 years, there is finally a competition in Saxony and we, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig and a motivated organizational team. Let's work together to ensure that the **Rahn Education Leipzig** competition becomes a traditional event in the WCA.

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

[FR] **Cette compétition est en série**

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Open de Gatineau A 2023. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée.

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule).
En raison de la situation sanitaire, les conditions d'accès à la compétition peuvent changer au gré des annonces gouvernementales. L'équipe d'organisation vous informera des restrictions en vigueur à chaque changement.

Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet [Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpendeGatineauB2023#25349-sante-securite-health-safety).

Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée.

**Avis de droit à l'image**: Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

[EN] **This competition is in a series**

This competition is in a series with Open de Gatineau A 2023. You will only be able to compete in one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule).
Due to the sanitary situation, the conditions for accessing the competition venue can vary due to the government's announcements. The organization team will inform everybody of the restrictions as they change. 

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpendeGatineauB2023#25349-sante-securite-health-safety).

There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

**Notice of Filming and Photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Pickering D 2023
items.information:
## Pickering 2023 Series

We are running four competitions as part of the Pickering 2023 Series. You will only be able to compete in *one* of these four competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

items.name: Save Ramir Cubing Kazakhstan 2023
items.information:
Соревнование проводится с благотворительной целью. Все вырученные средства пойдут в помощь сбору средств на лечение 3-летнего ребенка с инвалидностью Рамира Ковалевского, с диагнозом «Спинальная мышечная атрофия 2 типа», который нуждается в  самом дорогостоящем лекарственном препарате в мире, ZOLGENSMA.

Главный спонсор соревнования – компания «Леовит». Соревнование проводится при поддержке школы №157 и общественного фонда «Alem Asar».. 

Смотрите наш аккаунт в Instagram (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers), чтобы узнавать новости и подробную информацию о соревновании!

Соревнование будет проходить в спортзале школы №157.

Будем рады видеть вас на соревновании! 

Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында өткізеді. Жарыстан бүкіл түскен қаражат спиналды бұлшық атрофия диагнозына шалдыққан мүгедекке 3 жасар бала Рамир Ковалевскийге әлемде ең бағалы дәрі «ZOLGENSMA» сатып алу үшін қаржы жинауға және көмектесуге бағыттайды

Жарыстың бас демеушісі – «Леовит» компаниясы. Жарыс мектептiң №157 мен «Alem Asar» қоғамдық қорының көмегiмен өткiзіледi. 

Біздің Instagram аккаунтымыздың парақшасында (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) жаңалықтар және жарыс туралы ақпарат көре аласыздар!

Жарыс мектептің №157 спорт залында өткізіледі.

Сіздің жарысқа белсенді ат салысып қатысқаныңызға қуаныштымыз! 


 
The competition is organised for charity. All the proceeds made from the competition will be spent for fundraising for helping 3-years old kid, Ramir Kovalevsky, in his spinal muscular atrophy medical treatment to purchase him the most expensive cure in the world, ZOLGENSMA.

The Leovit company is the main sponsor of the competition. The competition is organised with the help of school #157 and Alem Asar social foundation.

Watch our posts in our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) to learn the news and more information about the competition! 

The competition will be set in the sports hall of the school #157.

We will be happy to see you at the competition!

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

---

* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

items.name: Please Be Quiet Joburg 2023
items.information:
### This is not a normal competition

We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is focused on blindfolded events, with a single fewest move attempt to keep things interesting.

If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province.

**Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund.

### Venue

The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue.
There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information:

1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number.
2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with.
3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this.

Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address.

### Guests

Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. 

### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

## London Winter 2023 Series

The London Winter 2023 Series is a collaboration between the **Western University Cube Club** and **Speedcubing Canada**.  

This competition is in a series with [London Winter A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LondonWinterA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

Speedcubing Canada is aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## London Winter 2023 Series

The London Winter 2023 Series is a collaboration between the **Western University Cube Club** and **Speedcubing Canada**.  

This competition is in a series with [London Winter B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LondonWinterB2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

Speedcubing Canada is aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Fasching 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

We are happy to announce the Vienna Fasching 2023 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

# 🇺🇾
Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro.

* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaSideEvents2023#25090-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaSideEvents2023#25091-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 35.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaSideEvents2023#25090-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaSideEvents2023#25091-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png)
# 🇺🇾
Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 35.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
お待たせしました。関西では実に約3年ぶりとなるWCA大会を、京都で開催します。

**昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。
この状況を緩和するため、異なる地域で複数のWCA大会を同時開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。
Go x Go Kyoto 2023、 Tokyo Challenge A/B/C Winter 2023のうち、ご都合の良いもの１つに申し込んでください。**

新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。
飛び込みでの競技参加や同伴、見学はできません。同伴を希望の場合、参加申し込み時に同伴者数をご記入ください。
見学を希望の場合、実行委員会宛に2/5までにフォームにてお申込みください。 詳細は["見学や競技者への同伴"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoxGoKyoto2023#23896-request-for-observation-as-a-visitor)のタブをご確認ください。

Thank you for your patience. The WCA competition will be held in Kyoto, the first in the Kansai region in about three years.

**In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them.
To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions in different regions at the same time.
Please register for one of Go x Go Kyoto 2023 or Tokyo Challenge A/B/C Winter 2023, whichever is most convenient for you.**

The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure.
If you are not a competitor or their guest and that you want to observe the competition, please be sure to apply to the organization team before 5th February.
Please check ["Spectators and Guests" ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoxGoKyoto2023#23896-request-for-observation-as-a-visitor)tab for details.

Competitors can change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

Competitors can also modify their registration through the Register tab.

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is Feburary 4th , 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time.

Tokyo Challenge Winter A 2023(**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) 、Tokyo Challenge Winter B 2023(**以下、B大会**) (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeWinterB2023) 及びTokyo Challenge Winter C 2023(**以下、C大会**) (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeWinterC2023) はWCA シリーズ大会です。
A大会、B大会およびC大会のうち１つの大会だけに参加できます。

### 競技参加者以外の来場要件
新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。
当日飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。

会場面積の制限、および感染症拡大防止のため同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。
未成年（18歳以下）及び配慮が必要な競技者一人につき一名の同伴者にご来場していただけます（無料）。
上記の同伴者以外の方で会場に来て見学されたい方（以下「見学者」）は有料（1,000円）となります。また会場の広さの都合上、見学者の入場を制限させていただく場合があります（原則として見学者は申し込み順で受け付けています。申し込み制限人数に達した場合は見学をお断りします。）

### サポーター募集
より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。
後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。

### Concept
Speed Cubing Challenge aims to "challenge" as many people as possible to break their own records.

**All events are 3x3x3 cube (1 round) only.**

In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them.
To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions in different regions at the same time.
Please register for one of Go x Go Kyoto 2023 or Tokyo Challenge Winter A/B/C 2023, whichever is most convenient for you.

### WCA Series Competitions
WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can only participate in one of them.
If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be accepted, and the others will be invalid.

Tokyo Challenge Winter A 2023 (**This Competition / hereinafter referred to as "Competition A**"), Tokyo Challenge Winter B 2023 (**Competition B**) (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeWinterB2023) and Tokyo Challenge Winter C 2023 (**Competition C**) (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeWinterC2023) are WCA series competitions.
You can participate in only one of the A, B and C competitions.

### Requirements for non-competitors
Due to the new coronavirus infection (COVID-19) control measures, the number of visitors to the venue will be limited.
No one will be allowed to enter the venue on the day of the event without any prior permission.

Due to the limited area of the venue and to prevent the spread of infectious diseases, there are restrictions on the number of accompanying persons and observers.
One accompanying person is allowed for each competitor who is a minor (18 years old or younger) or requires special consideration (free of charge).
Visitors other than the above-mentioned accompanying persons who wish to come and observe the event (hereinafter referred to as "visitors") will be charged a fee (1,000 yen). Due to the size of the venue, admission to visitors may be limited (in principle, visitors are accepted in the order of application. If the number of applicants reaches the limit, no visitors will be allowed.)

### Supporters Wanted
In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions.
We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

items.information:
AVISO: Si eres nuevo, recomendamos acudir a una ['competición normal'](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) antes. Este open será un test para competiciones similares, en las que cada competidor realizará medias en los eventos que quiera en el orden que quiera. Para participar, a parte de registrarse en le WCA, es necesario rellenar el [siguiente formulario](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), y asistir a los dos grupos, de inicio a fin. Más información en la pestaña de FUNCIONAMIENTO DE LA COMPETICIÓN.

OHARRA: Zure lehen lehiaketa bada, aurretik ['lehiaketa arrunt'](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) batera joatea gomendatzen dizugu. Open hau antzeko lehiaketetarako test bat izango da, lehiakide bakoitzak nahi dituen ekitaldietako batez bestekoak egingo ditu nahi duen ordenan. Parte hartzeko ezinbestekoa da [formulario hau](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66) betetzea, eta bi taldeetan egon, hasieratik amaierara. Informazio gehiago LEHIAKETAREN FUNTZIONAMENDUA erlaitzean.

WARNING: If you're a new competitor, we recommend you attend a ['normal' competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) first. This competition will be a test, in which each competitor will do their averages in the order they want. To participate at this competition, it is mandatory to fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), and also attend both groups. More information at the HOW WILL THE COMPETITION WORK tab.

items.name: Athens Winter Open 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2N0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83fc6c836b78e431cd8e0d013efd6be412a6e388/IMG_9500.JPG)
Athens Winter Open 2023 είναι ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα , ύστερα από μία πολλά υποσχόμενη χρονιά. Στις επόμενες διοργανώσεις, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 διοργανώσεις που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστές στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 6x6 και του 7x7 πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλες οι εκδηλώσεις θα είναι οικείες στους συμμετέχοντες.

Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή για το cubing γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείτε ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca και να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 


Athens Winter Open 2023 is the first competition this year in Greece, following a very successfull year of competitions.
In the next competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 6x6 and 7x7 closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors.

Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the eca site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.information:
Kick off the 2023 cubing season in Gauteng with a two day competition in Centurion.


### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial" to be held at the start of Sunday. If you are a new competitor who is competing in any events on Saturday, please speak to a delegate who will show you how to compete and perform the above duties.

We also recommend that you take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 


### SPONSOR

[CubeCo](https://cubeco.co.za/) is sponsoring this competition, and will be offering cubes for sale on the day. 


### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open A 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång på en **fredag** och i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Denna tävling har endast grenarna 3x3x3 och 2x2x2, och riktar sig främst till elever och lärare på Ålidenskolan, men alla andra är självklart också välkomna att delta. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen.

**OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag.

--

A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time on a **Friday** and in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! This competition only has the events 3x3x3 and 2x2x2, and is primarily aimed at students and teachers at Ålidenskolan, but everyone else is of course also welcome to participate. items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag.

--

A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

**N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

# 🇺🇾
Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 35.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2023. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/202509-cubingza-cape-cubes-summer-2023) page.

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.
Esta competição será realizada em um formato diferente do tradicional, neste campeonato, os competidores terão uma hora de limite para fazer todos os eventos que quiserem na ordem em que desejarem. Em um grupo serão juízes, no outro, competidores e em outro, embaralhadores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners
This competition will happen in a format different from the traditional, at this competition, the competitors will have an hour to do all the events they want in the order they want. In a group they will be judges, on the other, competitors and in a last one, scramblers.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

## Appleby Winter 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Appleby Winter A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApplebyWinterA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło aż 54 turnieje w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted 54 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.
